title: Volume 1 Chapter 1: Kyouka Uzen's Arc 3
content: "You're such a child, honestly."
Before she knew it, Kyouka was gently stroking Yuki's head as he nestled against her chest.
The strict Kyouka during training was now tenderly embracing him.
After the reward ended, Kyouka adjusted her clothing.
"Alright, let's return to training. The spoiled one will be disciplined."
"Is it alright to jump straight into training?"
"I can switch gears with my routine."
Kyouka's cheeks were flushed, but she quickly regained her composure.
Once again, Yuki faced Kyouka in his slave form.
He thought he had steadied his breathing.
"You haven't switched gears yourself, Yuki. You're still flustered."
Kyouka saw right through him.
Just moments ago, the master who had Yuki's face buried in her chest was now launching a serious attack.
Yuki intended to switch his mindset, but it wasn't complete.
"You can't always enter battle in peak condition!"
Yuki was being thoroughly scolded by Kyouka.
However, he didn't feel dissatisfied even after being beaten down; he believed Kyouka was right.
"Do you understand, Yuki?"
"Y-yes, I understand."
Yuki returned to his human form.
Kyouka leaned in closer to him.
This time, the reward was a kiss.
Kyouka, who had been scolding him until now, had sweet lips and breath.
"Kyouka-san."
"Stay quiet, you pervert. Mm, chu..."
With that, Kyouka pressed her lips against Yuki's.
Their lips met rhythmically.
"I'm going to put my tongue in."
Kyouka slipped her tongue inside, slickly licking Yuki's mouth.
"Mm, just like always, I can taste you."
"Is it that distinctive? Is it perhaps bad?"
"It's not bad. I'm continuing."
Eventually, Kyouka gently entwined her tongue with Yuki's.
With her arms wrapped around his back, holding him tightly, Yuki surrendered himself completely.
Their lips parted.
Their gazes intertwined.
"Let's resume training."
Kyouka seemed to have switched gears immediately.
Once again, Yuki and Kyouka faced each other.
Then, Yuki suddenly let out a roar.
"You forced the battle switch by shouting. That's the spirit, but—"
While he was shouting, Yuki was being beaten down.
"You're wide open. Switch more smartly and concisely."
Even as the sun set, Yuki continued to be trained by Kyouka.
And once the training was over, Yuki was led to the shower.
"So this time the reward is a bath together. You want me to wash your body, you pervert."
"I-I thought I was sticky with sweat, so I apologize."
"Stay still; I'll scrub you thoroughly."
Yuki was being vigorously scrubbed on the back by Kyouka.
"Does it sting? You'll just have to endure it."
With that, Kyouka gently licked his wounds.
"Thank you, Kyouka-san, for going out of your way."
"This is the kind of reward it is, so just accept it."
When they stepped out of the shower, they realized it was already deep into the night.
"I'll hurry and make something."
"Tonight, I'll cook dinner."
"W-wait, but—"
"Sometimes, it's nice to do that. You must be tired."
"If we're talking about tiredness, it's you, Kyouka-san."
"Hmph, I'm full of energy."
Kyouka spun her arms around.
Yuki quickly realized she wasn't just putting on a brave face.
"I can keep up too. You just healed me earlier, Kyouka-san."
"Ahem, don't mention that again."
Kyouka coughed, her face turning red.
"It's more of a reward than a thank you. For some reason, I wanted to make it for you. Just accept it honestly."
"I'm looking forward to Kyouka-san's cooking."
"I'd rather you not expect too much."
"Can I watch you cook up close?"
"Don't get in the way. From a professional's perspective, your knife skills are still lacking."
With that, Kyouka swiftly chopped eggplants and cucumbers into tiny pieces.
"I couldn't even see the knife movements; they were too fast."
"This is something I often ate back home during summer."
Saying that, she chopped green onions and myoga, adding them in, then poured in soy sauce and mixed it all together.
"This is called dashi."
It has a great texture.
It's because of how well you cut the eggplants and cucumbers.
There's a delicious mix of vegetables.
"It's also delicious over tofu. I often put it over rice, see?"
"That's wonderful as a condiment. Does that mean we get to enjoy a full course of Yamagata regional cuisine tonight?"
"No, that's the end of the regional dishes. I can make imoni as well."
As she said that, Kyouka boldly tossed fish, shellfish, and squid into the pot.
"It's a seafood hot pot."
"I like this kind of thing. It's summer, but I'm going for a hot pot."
"Yeah, it has a wild flavor."
"The dashi is delicious."
"Kyouka-san, wouldn't it be alright to have a drink or two?"
"I'm not drinking now. Instead, let's put udon in for the finish."
Kyouka remained serious to the end.
After finishing dinner, the two took a moment to relax while eating dessert, warabi mochi.
"It's so wobbly and delicious. The melting sweetness is nice. Truly a famous confection."
"I appreciate you preparing such sweets."
"Mm. The aroma of kinako is lovely."
"Kyouka-san, shall we continue from last night? The one where we ask each other questions."
"Hmm. That one is interesting because we do it occasionally."
"I want to do it."
Yuki stared intently at Kyouka.
"What’s with you? You're quite the beggar."
Yuki could tell that Kyouka was in a good mood.
"Fine, I’ll allow it. Just a little, though."
"Thank you. Last night, it ended with you asking the questions, right?"
"Since you're begging, you must have something you want to know, right? Go ahead, Yuki."
"While sparring with you, I was once again amazed by the intimidation of your sword."
"Ah, my sword."
"That sword is custom-made, right?"
"Of course. It's a sword forged by a swordsmith named Kaname Gibu, who is also a power user."
"Is it a power that creates swords?"
"It's a power that enhances the quality of the swords I forge. It becomes a sword capable of defeating Shuki."
"I'd like to hear about how you obtained it."
"It seems you're drawn to this sword; that's fine."
Kyouka showed her sword to Yuki.
"I met Gibu shortly after joining the Anti-Demon Corps. I had broken the sword I was issued."
In a workshop in Gifu, Kyouka faced Kaname.
"I want a sword that will never break, Gibu-san."
"You always think that way when forging, Kyouka."
"But it broke when I cut a larger Shuki."
"I couldn't believe it when I heard you didn't break it with your power. You just fought normally and it broke."
"Even Shimozura, the squad leader, chuckled at that."
"That's why I came all the way to the mountains of Gifu to speak directly."
"I need you to put all your intent into it. I want a sword to eradicate Shuki."
"You have quite the intense gaze, Kyouka. In a way, you're just like me."
"Yes, I felt the same aura from you, Gibu-san."
"My reason for living is to create weapons."
"My goal is to defeat Shuki. I will make the most of Gibu-san's sword."
"Alright, I'll forge you the best sword. I have to say that, or you won't be satisfied."
"Thank you."
"I want to see you wield the sword in person once. After I burn the image into my mind, I'll get to work."
"Okay. Like this?"
"Such power! A normal sword would break just from that swing."
"Ha! Hah!"
"With swordsmanship like that, it's impressive at your age."
"I've honed my skills with a single-minded desire to defeat Shuki!"
My father was a swordsmith.
I thought he was cool as I watched him, and before I knew it, I had become his successor.
My power was also suited for forging.
"So you're a specialist in forging, then."
I can't do anything else, but I take pride in my forging skills.
That's why I respect fellow specialists.
Plus, I'm being asked to create tools for that specialist, so it's really motivating.
"The sword that took time to complete is this one."
"Even I, as a novice, can tell it's an amazing sword."
Occasionally, I go to Gibu-san for maintenance.
When I hand over the sword, she can accurately guess how many Shuki I've defeated.
"You go all the way to Gifu, huh?"
"I'll introduce you to Gibu-san someday. She's a stoic person, but just watching her work cleanses the soul."
"I'll strive to be able to confidently say I'm a pro at housework too."
"It's turned into quite a long story. Shall we sleep soon?"
"Yes."
"If you can't sleep again, just call for me."
"It's deep into the night, so I think I'll sleep well."
True to her words, Yuki fell into a deep sleep.
On the third morning since arriving at the resort, the day to return to the Anti-Demon Corps had come.
"You were shouting in your sleep last night."
"Eh?"
"You were calling my name."
"I was training even in my dreams."
The serious duo finished tidying up while conversing.
"There's just the return trip left, but I have one last thing to confirm. Do you remember?"
"Of course. It's the second goal we set on the first day we came here."
"That's right. Let's announce the second goal right away."
"Yes. How are we supposed to announce it?"
"On three. One, two..."
They both revealed the second goals they had written in their notebooks.
"Deepening my connection with Yuki."
"Deepening my connection with Kyouka-san."
"This is..."
"Hehe. It seems we have similar master and slave goals. Did I achieve my goal?"
"Achieved? More than achieved, it was a great success. We had many conversations. How about me?"
"Well, let's say you passed."
"I did it! I deepened my bond with Kyouka-san!"
"Keep your voice down."
"I'm happy to deepen my bond with my master."
At that moment, a single sound of a conch shell echoed from Kyouka's device.
"It's from Himari."
"! An emergency message from Mato."
"A large army of Shuki has appeared two kilometers south of the 7th Squad dormitory."
"Ugh, just when we were enjoying a peaceful time!"
"Since it appeared on the last day of our return, I can't complain."
"What should we do?"
"I'll ride you and dash over. It's faster that way."
Kyouka extended her hand.
Yuki instinctively crouched down and kissed her hand.
Yuki transformed into his slave form.
"We're going to make them submit, Yuki!"
"Yes!!"
With their spirits high, the master and slave swiftly dashed through the mountainous region.
They arrived in Mato and defeated the Shuki without any struggle.
(The more I train, the more I respond. You're the best slave, Yuki!)
Kyouka was convinced that with their master-slave relationship, they could achieve great ambitions.
